content.content: Every verb answers its argument surface before it reaches for the workspace. `--help` is answered from any context, root-less included, with the verb's own line; an argument the form does not name — and a missing required flag — is refused, naming it, at the same point. Neither waits on a workspace, while the operation the verb performs still refuses on a root-less context (S3-root-required).
content.rationale: D11 (oqnsuzqu) and xlvoxmyl fix what --help answers; S3-root-optional (vxvsvzns) makes a root-less directory a state, not a resolution failure; S3-root-required (wpomwoxt) scopes the refusal to the operation. A discovery surface and a typo refusal are what a caller uses before deciding to init, so the store is an operation concern and the surface answers before it is taken.
